product.title: The Wrecker 1913 Robert Louis Stevenson Lloyd Osbourne Scribners Illustrated HC
product.description:
The Wrecker — Robert Louis Stevenson & Lloyd Osbourne

A 1913 illustrated Charles Scribner’s Sons printing of this adventure novel, bound in green ribbed cloth with a gilt front monogram and gilt spine lettering.

Condition

Used antique hardcover; no dust jacket. Cloth shows rubbing, scuffs and small spots/marks, with wear and bumping at corners and spine ends. Pages and edges are age toned, with scattered spotting/foxing, including at the frontispiece margins. The frontispiece tissue guard is present and has toning and creasing. Uneven page edges and minor preliminary-page creasing/edge wear are visible. Not inspected page by page; completeness of all text and illustrations and binding strength have not been fully verified. Please review all eight photographs.

Details

  • Title: The Wrecker
  • Authors: Robert Louis Stevenson and Lloyd Osbourne
  • Publisher: Charles Scribner’s Sons, New York
  • Title-page date: 1913; copyright: 1891
  • Later illustrated printing
  • English-language green cloth hardcover
  • Approximately 7¾ × 5¼ × 1⅜ inches; book-only weight 1 lb 6.3 oz

Included

One hardcover book. No dust jacket.

Packing & Shipping

Protected against moisture and packed in a rigid box with board and corner protection. Buyer-paid calculated USPS Media Mail shipping. Two-business-day handling. Returns accepted within 30 days; buyer pays return shipping.
